says: In next/, L15 (use in two tabs, W2) waited 30 s for tab t1's checklist 'Add an item' textbox on its first property case (seed 119120, path 0), with no code change behind it. The likely cause is a lost wakeup in next/packages/libfabrika/src/gateway/Gateway.ts: a knock that lands after a grant's drain is never woken; L15 grants as soon as tab 0 waits, while tab 1 may not have knocked yet.
proof: Run https://github.com/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/actions/runs/44216670632 job 134508456856, PR 1588 at 0d5efd6d: 'locator.waitFor: Timeout 30000ms exceeded ... checklist, t1 ... Add an item' at first-window.visual.test.ts:441:72. Gateway.ts on main: knock adds a waiting row without checking membership; the grant path drains waiting rows once, after the grant applies.
cost: Any pull request whose e2e legs run first-window can go red at random, and a person who opens a second tab while granting the first can see it stuck waiting.
